description: 命令 3D 虛擬辦公室裡的角色移動。後端只下命令,由開著的檢視器(console 的 /office/ 頁面)尋路與走路,抵達後回報。action:goto 走到地點(或角色旁邊)、find 去找某個角色、return 回自己的座位、stop 停下;或只給 text(例如「工程師 去 會議室」「ceo 找 旁白」「全部 回座位」,多條用;分開,會拆成多個命令)。角色與地點會先驗證,不合法回錯誤。沒有檢視器連線時命令狀態是 no_viewer(不會執行,也不會之後補送)。wait 給秒數就等到全部抵達(或失敗、被取代、逾時)才回傳。角色 id 與地點 id 用 office_state 查。命令狀態:pending(還沒送出)、delivered(已送達檢視器)、running(走路中)、arrived(抵達)、done(stop 完成)、partial(部分失敗)、failed、superseded(被新命令取代)、no_viewer。

agents.description: 角色 id 陣列(例如 ["engineer","ceo"]);也接受中文名稱或別名,["all"] 代表全部

target.description: goto:地點 id(例如 meeting、pantry、lounge、seat_ceo、zone_engineer)或角色 id(= find);find:角色 id。return、stop 不用

text.description: 自然語言命令(中英文都可以),給了就不要再給 action / agents / target

wait.description: 等抵達的秒數,0–120,預設 0(不等,馬上回傳命令 id 與狀態)

name: office_move
title: 虛擬辦公室:移動角色

description: 3D 虛擬辦公室目前的狀態:連線中的檢視器(哪一個是主檢視器)、每個角色最後回報的位置/狀態(idle、walking、waiting、arrived)/是否坐著/所在地點、最近的命令與每個角色的命令狀態,以及可用的地點 id 與名稱。只讀。

command.description: 只看這個命令 id 的狀態

limit.description: 最多列幾個最近的命令,預設 20,最多 200

name: office_state
title: 虛擬辦公室:狀態

annotations.title: Withdraw a pending decision / help request

description: Withdraws a decision or help request that is still open (status=open). Allowed for the creator or an organization admin; anyone else gets 403, and an item that is not open gets 409. The withdrawn item stays visible with status=withdrawn. Console-only tool, forwarded to the core's POST /api/orgs/{org}/decisions/{id}/withdraw. Returns the updated item.
name: issue_decision_withdraw
title: Withdraw a pending decision / help request

annotations.title: Reopen a handled decision / help request

description: Reopens a decision or help request that has already been handled (status=decided): the answer, note and evidence are cleared and it is open again, and a comment is written on the source issue. Allowed for an organization admin or the original handler; anyone else gets 403, and an item that is not decided gets 409. Humans only (agent credentials are rejected). Console-only tool, forwarded to the core's POST /api/orgs/{org}/decisions/{id}/reopen. Returns the updated item.
name: issue_decision_reopen
title: Reopen a handled decision / help request
